The company is fully owned by the Kavli Trust, a charitable trust that donates all profits to good causes.

pages.title: ABOUT US | Kavli Holding
pages.main_text_excerpt:
ABOUT US
Kavli was founded in 1893, when Olav Kavli opened a small cheese shop in Bergen, Norway. In 1924, he established his first factory, where he went on to invent the world’s first spreadable cheese - Primula - marking the beginning of an exciting journey of innovation and growth.
Today, Kavli Holding AS owns and operates food businesses in Norway, Sweden, Finland, and the UK. The company employs more than 1,000 people and produces and markets strong brands with annual sales exceeding €400 million. The strong local brands include Kavli, Q-Meieriene, Skyr®, Primula, Castle MacLellan, Eriks, Johnny’s and El Taco Truck. 
Kavli is driven by a unique purpose: “We create value for good causes.” All our profits go back to society - supporting meaningful causes and creating real impact.

pages.title: Kavli Norway | Kavli Holding
pages.main_text_excerpt:
KAVLI NORWAY
Since 1924, Kavli Norway has turned proud traditions into innovative food experiences. Best known for its iconic spreadable cheese in tubes, Kavli creates products enjoyed by generations.
Q‑Meieriene, launched in 2000, brings a bold and innovative edge to the Norwegian dairy market - driven by quality, openness, and consumer choice. Q-Meieriene prides itself by being relevantly different than competition and believes strongly that anything can be done in a better way.

pages.title: Kavli Sweden | Kavli Holding
pages.main_text_excerpt:
KAVLI SWEDEN
Kavli Sweden grew from introducing tubes with spreadable cheese to becoming a strong player in the Swedish grocery market. Today, cheese spreads remain at its core, alongside a wider portfolio of mustards, sauces, dressings and vinegar.
With production in Älvsjö and Eslöv, Kavli Sweden combines local expertise with strong brands such as Kavli, Johnny’s, Eriks, Hultbergs, Västerviks Senap, Perstorp Ättika and El Taco Truck - delivering quality products to consumers across the country.
